_doc: Known structural-failure baseline for the ASHRAE 140 strict +/-15% annual-energy gate (issue #2506). The Case 600/900 annual COOLING physics gap is NOT yet fixed (tracked by the post-#1323 / #1213 / #1328 cooling-load chain); these two metrics are expected to FAIL the +/-15% band today. The strict-energy-gate workflow runs the two `#[ignore]`'d strict tests with `--include-ignored`, parses the printed H/C values, computes each metric's gap as a percentage of the band midpoint, and compares against this baseline. The gate FAILS only when a metric REGRESSES beyond `regression_tolerance_pp` percentage points worse than its recorded `gap_pct_of_mid` (or when a previously-`pass` metric starts failing beyond the tolerance). When the physics is fixed and a cooling metric re-enters its band (gap == 0), lower its value here and eventually un-ignore the tests (issues #1333 / #2506 acceptance). Do NOT raise a baseline gap to make a regression disappear (RULES.md: no parameter tuning).
_rule: Per AGENTS.md / RULES.md: this file records the KNOWN gap; it must never be loosened to hide a regression. Only lower a gap when the engine genuinely improved, and commit the improving change together with the baseline update.
source_path: run_blind_annual_energy() in tests/zone_balance_eplus_isolation.rs (blind zone-balance path, NOT the Informed benchmark.rs path)
_tolerance_fraction_doc: Band edges = midpoint(published_range) * (1 +/- tolerance_fraction). Matches ANNUAL_TOLERANCE_PCT in tests/zone_balance_eplus_isolation.rs.
_regression_tolerance_pp_doc: A metric may get at most this many percentage-points worse (relative to band midpoint) than its recorded gap_pct_of_mid before the gate fails for regression. Absorbs cross-runner numerical noise; tuned for deterministic release builds. A previously-passing metric (gap 0) that drifts outside the band by more than this tolerance ALSO trips the gate.
